{phase_info}

player_prompt.phase_learning: KUKHALA NA MAZGU: Uyo watonda pa maseŵero ghose wakutorapo kadi lakunyoloskeka ndipo uyo watondeka wakupokaso khadi linyake. Maseŵera agho ghathereskeka mu chigaŵa ichi ghakutovwira yayi kuti titonde nkhondo iyi.

next_card.playing_phase: Palije khadi ilo likupelekeka - maseŵero gha kwambira.
next_card.deck_empty: Sitaha ya kadi imekwisha - hakuna kadi iliyo wazi.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Chosankha cholakwika. Gwiritsani ntchito '[play N]' kusewera khadi la Nth m'manja mwanu.
invalid_move.bad_position: Palije apo pali makadi agha. Mukukora {hand_size} khadi.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: Mukwenera kulondezga ivyo wakuyowoya na kuseŵera khadi la {lead_suit}.
invalid_move.invalid_play: Tikwenera yayi kugwiliskira nchito khadi ili.

trick.won_learning: Mchezaji {winner_id} anashinda chwajo hicho na {card} na akatwala kadi iliyo wazi.

phase.learning_complete: Sitaha ya kadi imekwisha. Kipindi cha kujifunza kimekwisha - kila trick iliyobaki inahesabiwa kuelekea ushindi.

draw.loser_received: Mwaleka ciphalizgano ndipo mwalemba {card} pa deck.

turn.scores_learning: Trick zilizoshinda mpaka sasa - Mchezaji 0: {tricks0}, Mchezaji 1: {tricks1}

trick_view.empty: Bado hakuna kadi zilizochezwa katika trick hii.
